title: prompt-library-scratchpad-jordan-kim
content:
Quick scratchpad for prompt drafts and small experiments. Mostly notes to self + example few-shot sets. Leaving raw - TODO: move good ones to /shared_drives/product/hosted-api/prompt-templates once cleaned.

Goals:
- curate a small library of templates for chat generation, instruction-to-code, and system+user role setups.
- capture failure cases and edge prompts that cause hallucination or verbosity blowups.
- try consistent scoring prompts for quality regression tests (BLEU-like, but also semantic checks).

Notes (stream-of-consciousness):
- Template idea: short-system + 3-shot + user-instruction + explicit "constraints" section. Keep system to 1 sentence. Example: "You are a concise assistant that cites sources and refuses speculation." Then 3 short exemplars.
- Exemplar format: Q -> desired-answer (1-2 sentences), and a short rationale line. Rationale helps steer style.
- For code generation tasks: include input/output shapes, minimal example, then a final test case. Avoid long-winded explanations.

Few-shot set: troubleshooting customer logs -> try to extract root cause and 2 suggested remediations.
1) input: "service X OOM at 11:03, reclaiming memory" -> output: "likely memory leak in worker; check recent deploy; suggest restart + heap dump"
2) input: "high 95th latency on inference CPU-bound" -> output: "throttle batching, check CPU steal, consider lower-precision model"
3) input: "500 errors for requests with large prompt" -> output: "prompt length issues; validate truncation; advise streaming or higher context config"

Failure cases observed (notes/dates):
- 2024-06-25: model hallucinated a citation when given ambiguous user-provided facts. Root cause: prompt encourages confident-sounding answers. Mitigation: add explicit "if not enough information, say 'insufficient info'" clause.
- 2024-07-09: for multi-turn instruction, model forgot earlier constraint (e.g., "be brief") after 4 turns. Mitigation: include constraint in every assistant-turn exemplar or append system restatement at each generation step.
- 2024-07-21: temperature=0.0 still produced byzantine phrasing in code comments. Hypothesis: few-shot exemplars had verbose comments. Fix: shorten exemplars and add "concise comments" explicit instruction.

Quick templates (raw):
- "system: You are a concise assistant. user: <instruction>. examples: [ex1, ex2, ex3]. constraints: <max tokens: N; cite: yes/no; format: bullet list>. output:"
- "code-spec: Provide function signature + short docstring + 2-line example usage. If unable, respond 'INSUFFICIENT'."

Evaluation prompts (for automated checks):
- "Does the answer include unsupported facts? (yes/no) -> follow-up ask for source lines"
- "Is the answer actionable? (yes/no) -> expect at least 1 concrete instruction"

Experiment ideas to run:
- Sweep: system phrasing (concise vs explanatory) x exemplar count (1,3,5) x constrain repetition (none vs repeated) -> metric: constraint adherence and hallucination rate.
- Failure injection: feed partially contradictory facts and see whether model prefers newer or older facts. We can simulate with 200 synthetic dialogs.
- Reranking experiment: produce 5 candidates and run a cheap critic prompt to pick best; compare to single-shot deterministic generation.

Scratch TODOs:
- [ ] formalize 5 highest-quality templates and add to shared_drives/product/hosted-api/prompt-templates (owner: Asha)
- [ ] add evaluation harness for "insufficient info" test (owner: Samir)
- [ ] record a short demo notebook showing reranking pipeline with Redwood API streaming (owner: Jordan)

Misc notes:
- Keep prompt lengths reasonable (<1200 tokens) for hosted default. When testing long-context, note model variant and kv-cache behavior.
- For private deployments: some customers prefer not to include examples with PII; include synthetic or redacted examples in templates.

Random raw examples to iterate on:
1) "You are an assistant that cites sources. Q: How to reduce inference cost? A: Use batching (cite: internal doc 5), quantization (cite: blog/quant), caching. If unsure, say INSUFFICIENT."
2) "System: Extract 3 action items from the note. Keep each item <10 words. If none, respond 'NONE'.
Note: <raw meeting text>"

Keeping this loose - will refine into structured library once we have 10 high-signal templates and clear evaluation tests.

References/links: Confluence prompt-library overview (see linked_artifacts), PR for eval harness in repo (linked), internal slack thread #prompt-library (search: "prompt-library kickoff").
